title: Business Capability Dependency Graph
purpose: Show dependencies among all 20 business capabilities organized into six layers: Enabling, Core Commerce, Engagement, Growth, Governance, and Productivity. IAM is the root dependency; Payment Processing is the most-depended-on hub.
audience: Product managers, architects, engineering leads, business stakeholders
description: Dependency graph across all 20 business capabilities with color-coded layers. IAM sits at the root and feeds every other capability. Payment Processing serves as the central hub with 5 dependents (Subscription Commerce, Tipping, PPV, Referral System). Subscription Commerce feeds Content Feed and Contests. Real-Time Messaging feeds Notifications and Support Tickets. Content Feed and Content Gallery both feed Content Moderation. Admin Dashboard consumes Analytics and Support Tickets. Enclave is the most isolated — it depends only on IAM. The graph reveals that Payment Processing is a high-risk single point of failure: if payments go down, 5 capabilities are affected.

modules.label: Identity & Access Management
modules.description: Register, authenticate, authorize users across three roles (fan, creator, admin). Foundation capability.

modules.label: User Profiles
modules.description: Profile CRUD, avatar upload, onboarding, verification, settings, payment methods.

modules.label: Platform Settings
modules.description: Platform-wide configuration management.

modules.label: Payment Processing
modules.description: Accept and verify payments via Stripe (credit card) and crypto (Base USDC). Captures 12.5% platform commission.

modules.label: Subscription Commerce
modules.description: Tiered subscription plans; fans subscribe for recurring access. Primary revenue model.

modules.label: Tipping
modules.description: One-time tips from fans to creators via crypto or Stripe.

modules.label: PPV (Pay-Per-View)
modules.description: One-time payments to unlock individual content items.

modules.label: Content Feed
modules.description: Personalized content feed from subscribed creators, reverse chronological, paginated.

modules.label: Content Gallery
modules.description: Fans bookmark/save content into a personal gallery for later viewing.

modules.label: Real-Time Messaging
modules.description: Private one-to-one messaging between fans and creators with Socket.IO real-time delivery.

modules.label: Notifications
modules.description: In-app notifications for new content, tips, messages. DB-only, no push.

modules.label: Contests
modules.description: Time-limited contests (giveaways) to drive fan engagement.

modules.label: Referral System
modules.description: Users earn rewards by referring new users. Code generation, validation, bonus milestones.

modules.label: Enclave (Premium Tier)
modules.description: Exclusive, invite-only premium membership with limited spots. Applications only.

modules.label: Admin Dashboard
modules.description: Platform administration: dashboard, user management, content moderation, analytics, reports.

modules.label: Content Moderation
modules.description: Content flagging (auto after 3 reports), admin approve/remove, user suspension.

modules.label: Support Tickets
modules.description: Customer support ticket system with DM sync for replies.

modules.label: Analytics
modules.description: Event tracking (profile_visit, post_view, gallery_add), creator dashboard aggregation.

modules.label: AI Captions
modules.description: AI-powered caption generation for content images via OpenRouter/OpenAI.

modules.label: Bulk Upload
modules.description: Batch content upload with DropZone, DraftCards, per-draft AI caption generation.

preconditions: Platform has been initialized with database, auth provider, and payment integrations
All 20 capabilities have been identified and documented
postconditions: Dependency hierarchy is clearly visualized for impact analysis
Single points of failure (Payment Processing) are identified
